text: Open by framing this as a proposal. The project name is still under consideration, so the deck uses a descriptive working title rather than treating Osprey as final branding.
Web security protects the entire exposed application surface
textPreview: Web security protects the entire exposed application surface

text: Find, validate and reduce weaknesses before attackers exploit them.
textPreview: Find, validate and reduce weaknesses before attackers exploit them.

text: The surface includes domains, services, applications, APIs, identities, third-party components and the data connecting them.
textPreview: The surface includes domains, services, applications, APIs, identities, third-party components and the data connecting them.

text: A known web vulnerability became a large-scale breach
textPreview: A known web vulnerability became a large-scale breach

text: A critical Apache Struts vulnerability had a patch available.
textPreview: A critical Apache Struts vulnerability had a patch available.

text: The public dispute portal remained unpatched and verification did not catch it.
textPreview: The public dispute portal remained unpatched and verification did not catch it.

text: Personal information of about 147 million people was exposed.
textPreview: Personal information of about 147 million people was exposed.

text: A single missed internet-facing asset can defeat security across a very large organisation. Effective testing must discover the full surface, verify coverage, and preserve evidence across every step.
textPreview: A single missed internet-facing asset can defeat security across a very large organisation. Effective testing must discover the full surf...

text: Sources: U.S. House Oversight Committee report (2018); U.S. Federal Trade Commission (2019).
textPreview: Sources: U.S. House Oversight Committee report (2018); U.S. Federal Trade Commission (2019).

text: Explain that the Equifax breach was not caused by a lack of security tools. The organization had a patching process, but a complex legacy environment and failed verification left an internet-facing portal exposed. Official sources: https://oversight.house.gov/report/committee-releases-report-revealing-new-information-on-equifax-data-breach/ and https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2019/07/equifax-pay-575-million-part-settlement-ftc-cfpb-states-related-2017-data-breach
Pentesting today: proven tools, manual coordination—and now AI
textPreview: Pentesting today: proven tools, manual coordination—and now AI

text: The tools already exist. The unresolved problem is coordinating them across a wide target, choosing the next useful test, and retaining trustworthy context from discovery to reporting.
textPreview: The tools already exist. The unresolved problem is coordinating them across a wide target, choosing the next useful test, and retaining t...

text: Source: FYP defense report, literature review and comparison table, pp. 5–10.
textPreview: Source: FYP defense report, literature review and comparison table, pp. 5–10.

text: Walk across the upper row as the standard workflow a human tester already knows. Then point out that recent AI systems add reasoning and orchestration, but most still sit above fragmented tools or are evaluated in bounded environments. The ten names are drawn from the report and existing deck; they are presented as systems/frameworks, not as identical products.
The operational security gap is orchestration at scale
textPreview: The operational security gap is orchestration at scale

text: This is a practical security gap—not merely a research gap.
textPreview: This is a practical security gap—not merely a research gap.

text:
Specialized tools emit isolated outputs.

Humans repeatedly copy, filter, correlate and decide what to run next.

Assets, services, endpoints and evidence are easily disconnected.
textPreview: Specialized tools emit isolated outputs. |  | Humans repeatedly copy, filter, correlate and decide what to run next. |  | Assets, service...

text:
Real infrastructures are wider than bounded CTF tasks.

Each new domain, host, port or endpoint creates more work.

Many AI systems are not optimized for continuous, broad reconnaissance coverage.
textPreview: Real infrastructures are wider than bounded CTF tasks. |  | Each new domain, host, port or endpoint creates more work. |  | Many AI syste...

text:
API cost, rate limits, connectivity and model behavior can interrupt assessments.

Known pentesting steps do not require expensive reasoning every time.

When the model stops, the core workflow should not stop.
textPreview: API cost, rate limits, connectivity and model behavior can interrupt assessments. |  | Known pentesting steps do not require expensive re...

text: Trust and control must span the entire workflow
textPreview: Trust and control must span the entire workflow

text: Use the phrase operational security gap. The central argument is not that the industry lacks scanners; it lacks a dependable harness that can coordinate them over a changing, wide attack surface while keeping evidence and scope intact. Emphasize that LLMs are valuable but should not be mandatory for routine methodology.
What the proposed system must do
textPreview: What the proposed system must do

text: The CLI will unify engagement setup, tools, jobs, progress, evidence and reporting in one operator session.
textPreview: The CLI will unify engagement setup, tools, jobs, progress, evidence and reporting in one operator session.

text: A configurable methodology engine will drive battle-tested recon and vulnerability steps without requiring an LLM.
textPreview: A configurable methodology engine will drive battle-tested recon and vulnerability steps without requiring an LLM.

text: AI will deepen ambiguous leads, correlate across assets, test business logic and propose creative pivots.
textPreview: AI will deepen ambiguous leads, correlate across assets, test business logic and propose creative pivots.

text: Tool observations, hypotheses, candidates and verified findings will remain distinct and traceable.
textPreview: Tool observations, hypotheses, candidates and verified findings will remain distinct and traceable.

text: Authorized scope will be enforced and impactful actions will require explicit approval and logging.
textPreview: Authorized scope will be enforced and impactful actions will require explicit approval and logging.

text: Core principle: automate repeatable methodology; reserve model tokens for uncertainty, interpretation and genuinely adaptive testing.
textPreview: Core principle: automate repeatable methodology; reserve model tokens for uncertainty, interpretation and genuinely adaptive testing.

text: Derived from the project objectives and the identified operational gaps.
textPreview: Derived from the project objectives and the identified operational gaps.

text: These are requirements for the future system, not claims about a finished product. The distinction between deterministic intelligence and AI assistance is deliberate: the deterministic layer owns the standard methodology, while the AI layer adds judgment only where it changes the outcome.
A dual-mode pentesting harness with one shared source of truth
textPreview: A dual-mode pentesting harness with one shared source of truth

text: Crawl, enumerate and run baseline scanners
textPreview: Crawl, enumerate and run baseline scanners

text: Track coverage and react to new evidence
textPreview: Track coverage and react to new evidence

text: Require proof before a finding is verified
textPreview: Require proof before a finding is verified

text: Choose deeper tests and creative pivots
textPreview: Choose deeper tests and creative pivots

text: Analyze business logic and application behavior
textPreview: Analyze business logic and application behavior

text: Explain evidence and support the human operator
textPreview: Explain evidence and support the human operator

text: Do not spend API tokens rediscovering the standard playbook; spend them where human-like judgment changes the outcome.
textPreview: Do not spend API tokens rediscovering the standard playbook; spend them where human-like judgment changes the outcome.

text: This is the key proposal slide. Both modes use the same CLI, tools and evidence store. The deterministic engine is not a fallback script hidden behind one call; it is the baseline intelligence that continually decides which known methodology opportunity is ready next. AI observes the same evidence and adds adaptive depth.
The CLI will be the harness—not just another interface
textPreview: The CLI will be the harness—not just another interface

text: Every client uses the same scope, methodology, tools and evidence model. The CLI remains the main operational harness.
textPreview: Every client uses the same scope, methodology, tools and evidence model. The CLI remains the main operational harness.

text: Explain the architecture from top to bottom. The CLI owns the visible operator experience, while dashboard and MCP are additional clients rather than separate orchestration systems. This prevents duplicated brains and inconsistent state.
The baseline engine will behave like a pentester—not a fixed macro
textPreview: The baseline engine will behave like a pentester—not a fixed macro

text: A new host, service, endpoint, credential or vulnerability re-opens only the relevant earlier work—without restarting the engagement.
textPreview: A new host, service, endpoint, credential or vulnerability re-opens only the relevant earlier work—without restarting the engagement.

text: What makes this intelligent without an LLM
textPreview: What makes this intelligent without an LLM

text: A real live host or service creates new test opportunities.
textPreview: A real live host or service creates new test opportunities.

text: Each host and application is tracked individually, even on shared infrastructure.
textPreview: Each host and application is tracked individually, even on shared infrastructure.

text: Observed technologies, exposure and proof reorder the queue.
textPreview: Observed technologies, exposure and proof reorder the queue.

text: Teams can change policy and coverage without rewriting the engine.
textPreview: Teams can change policy and coverage without rewriting the engine.

text: This is not a single expansion tool and not a rigid checklist. The engine evaluates opportunities from current evidence, selects the next standard action, and loops when new facts change the surface. Nuclei, SQLmap and other baseline scanners remain part of the methodology; AI is not required to remember to run them.
One evidence model will prevent false positives and lost context
textPreview: One evidence model will prevent false positives and lost context

text: Artifacts preserve what the tool actually returned.
textPreview: Artifacts preserve what the tool actually returned.

text: A banner, port or scanner title cannot silently become a confirmed finding.
textPreview: A banner, port or scanner title cannot silently become a confirmed finding.

text: AI interpretations and candidate leads remain provisional until verified.
textPreview: AI interpretations and candidate leads remain provisional until verified.

text: Every high-impact claim points back to recorded, reproducible evidence.
textPreview: Every high-impact claim points back to recorded, reproducible evidence.

text: What has been tested is tracked separately from how dangerous a finding is.
textPreview: What has been tested is tracked separately from how dangerous a finding is.

text: CLI, deterministic engine and AI operate on the same connected state.
textPreview: CLI, deterministic engine and AI operate on the same connected state.

text: Use this slide to explain why the platform will not rely on promotion calculations or a mixed bucket of findings. Memory will reflect an evidence lifecycle: raw tool facts first, hypotheses and candidates separately, then verified findings only when proof exists. This reduces false positives without adding another complex scoring layer.
Comparable operation with and without an LLM.
textPreview: Comparable operation with and without an LLM.

text: Zero scope violations and measurable time improvement.
textPreview: Zero scope violations and measurable time improvement.

text: Present this as the planned schedule. The final evaluation will compare coverage, reliability across both modes, safety controls and time efficiency against manual baselines.
